Method of Attack: Scanning the Internet for devices with exposed Telnet ports and using a list of default credentials to attempt to log into devices and install Mirai DDoS malware
Using proof-of-concept exploit code targeting ZyXEL PK5001Z routers to automate login via default Telnet credentials and gain root privileges using a hardcoded su password
Attack Vector: Exposed Telnet ports (ports 23 and 2323) with default credentials admin/CentryL1nk and admin/QwestM0dem
Indicators of Compromise: Spike of scans on ports 23 and 2323 detected by Netlab
879 new unique IP addresses added to Mirai-like botnet on 2017-11-22
Around 100,000 IPs performing scans in 60 hours
Approximately 65,700 bots located in Argentina ISP Telefonica de Argentina network
